VBO:0201222.summary: The Shichon is a Shih Tzu–Bichon Frise companion cross, also called a Zuchon. Tiny Teddys describes more than two decades of breeding successive generations, rather than only mating the two parent breeds. Its keepers report close daily company, walks and learning games across several adult dogs; that experience describes one program, with character and appearance varying among lines and individuals.
VBO:0201222.shortDescription: A Shih Tzu–Bichon companion cross; one long-running program records daily company, walks and learning games.

sources.title: Tiny Teddys — named keeper and adult-owner accounts
sources.evidence: Actual signed Jyvanie and Thor account: fourth birthday, beach and forest trips, new tricks, treat puzzles, object searching, curious learning and sweet company. Actual Karen and Ken adult Oskar accounts: turns 13; separate preceding 12-year account records three daily walks, nightly floor play and accompanying owner at home office and RV trips. Bonnie and Bailey eight-year account records teaching a paw trick and close daily company. Original Mike and Corinne keeper account identifies multigenerational Shichon/Zuchon Shih Tzu–Bichon cross program, parent dogs sharing walks and naps; recognition is a future aim, not established fact. These actual observations support scoped recurring keeper tendencies, not universals.

sources.title: Tiny Teddys — Meet the Parents, original keeper observations
sources.evidence: Actual named keeper introduction identifies adult parent dogs as personal lifetime companions. Actual individual write-ups describe ChiChi seeking close contact and learning, Malakye fetch and learning games, Smucci companionship on outings, Sig fetch and learning new commands, and Loki keep-away/tug/fetch and obedience practice. Whole substantive page personally read. Generalized parent ancestry temperament transfer, universal sociability, health and service suitability claims excluded.

sources.title: Tiny Teddys — own cross definition and breeding-program scope
sources.evidence: Actual heading defines Shichon/Zuchon as Shih Tzu–Bichon cross hybrid descendants. Actual Health improvements paragraph identifies own multigenerational program over more than two decades; only program history and explicit generational scope used, not claimed medical benefits. Actual Description says mix may demonstrate any combination of traits, own program says every puppy unique. Actual Appearance describes own mature 5–18lb range, average 9–16lb, soft curly or sleek silky coat and varied colors; photographed mature anatomy remains primary for visual brief. Expected AKC recognition, disability-child origin story, hypoallergenic/health/longevity/no-prey-drive claims, inherited-parent intelligence and universal suitability excluded. Correction review 2026-10-06: Independently read substantive breed-info page 2026-10-06; own program reports over two decades of multigeneration breeding and explicitly variable individual traits. Existing original keeper/parent accounts retained for observed company, walks and learning games. Predicted recognition, inherited intelligence, health, allergy and suitability promises are excluded.
